locator.text: Any website is an installable web application.

consequence: installation is user-agent behaviour offered to the user, not something a manifest guarantees: the installed-Factory level L0 needs an installation OBSERVATION, never a manifest-only claim
excerpt:
Any website is an installable web application.

A user agent can provide a way for the end-user to install a web application on the end-user's device, allowing the user to instantiate a new [=top-level traversable=] with the manifest's members [=applied=].
